newsitem.title: POLAND: Raiffeisen Polish unit eyes bank purchase.
newsitem.headline: Raiffeisen Polish unit eyes bank purchase.

text.p: The Polish subsidiary of Raiffeisen Zentralbank Austria AG is interested in buying a middle sized Polish bank, the subsidiary's deputy president Wladyslaw Golebiewski said on Monday.

"The bank is interested in the privatisation of the Polish banking sector...If the National Bank of Poland offers to sell its Pierwszy Komercyjny Bank w Lublinie SA, our bank might be interested in such an offer," Golebiewski said.

He told reporters after opening the bank's sixth branch in the southern city of Krakow that the Polish Raiffeisen also planned to raise its capital by 30 million zlotys to 160 million before the end of the year.
He said the bank expected to open two new branches in the port of Szczecin and the the south-western city of Wroclaw still in the first half of this year.
He said that the next full branches could be opened in the cities of Lublin, Bialystok, Lodz and Kielce in 1998.
The Polish Raiffeisen currently has branches in Warsaw, Poznan, Katowice, Gdynia, Bydgoszcz and Krakow.
